bull_bear.body: CIC mandate: deploy capital to set up / nurture / scale operating subsidiaries under four principles (Reputation, Regulatory adherence, Return **of** capital, Return **on** capital). Treasury on incremental warrant proceeds run for safety/liquidity/yield until deployed. No dividend/buyback signalled.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Young, fast-growing loan book (AUM +163%) — asset quality unproven through a cycle; provisions only Rs 25 cr this qtr.
- Earnings quality: headline PAT leans on RIL dividend + treasury FV gains, not yet core operations.
- JV incubation losses (AMC/insurance/broking) will persist near-term.
- Execution/regulatory dependency on insurance approvals and broking launch.
- No Q&A — limited external scrutiny of the numbers this quarter.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Highly promotional, narrative-heavy (AI-native, flywheel, "personal CFO," "democratization"). New Group CFO gave a disciplined ex-dividend PBT bridge and was transparent that RSHL consolidation is PAT-neutral and that JV losses are incubation costs — the most grounded part of an otherwise marketing-forward call. Listen-only format limits accountability.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The "141% income growth" is partly an accounting artifact (RSHL line-by-line consolidation) with zero PAT effect — don't extrapolate top-line optics.
- The real operating proof points are the two payments turnarounds and NBFC PAT +113%, not the headline consol PAT.
- JioBlackRock hitting Rs 18,412 cr AUM in ~1 year (36% beyond top-30 cities, 18.5% new-to-MF) is a genuine distribution disruption to incumbent AMCs.
- Broking beta (Q2 FY27) puts JFS directly into ANGELONE/Groww/Zerodha territory next quarter.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Total Consolidated Shareholders' Equity of Rs. 1.37 lakh Cr as of June 30, 2026; 'Strong Capital Base' is listed as one of the five structural moats.
- JCL Capital Adequacy Ratio of 22.35%; borrowing mix given as 11% CP, 20% NCD, 65% Bank Loans (incl. WCDL and term loans) and 4% ICD and B-TREPS; Debt/Equity of 3.9x in Q1 FY27 (1.7x in Q1 FY26, 3.0x in Q4 FY26).
- JCL issued Rs. 1,500 Cr of NCDs in June 2026 against a Board-approved limit of Rs. 15,000 Cr for FY27.
- Reinsurance JV has established 'robust retrocession frameworks to maximise capital efficiency and advanced exposure management', and targets sustainable risk-adjusted returns by selectively participating in high-profitability market opportunities.
- Deck contains no dividend policy or payout commentary.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Jio Credit AUM mix: Mortgages (HL & LAP) 45.4%, Corporate & SME 44.2%, retail LAS 10.4% — deliberately balanced against macro volatility. Payments Bank = high-frequency engagement layer feeding lending/wealth/insurance funnels; live on FASTag ANPR multi-lane free-flow tolling across 20 toll plazas + Cash-on-UPI/BBPS via BC network. JPSL = RBI-regulated PA-PG targeting high-ticket merchants, offline affordability-led POS with EMI, and cross-border collections for exporters; variable-cost/asset-light model. business.body:
- Full-stack financial ecosystem organised as INVEST (JVs with BlackRock for asset management, wealth management and securities broking), BORROW (Jio Credit Limited), TRANSACT (Jio Payments Bank and Jio Payment Solutions) and PROTECT (Jio Insurance Broking plus JVs with Allianz for Reinsurance, General and Life; the Life JV is a signed non-binding agreement).
- Deck names five 'structural moats': Brand Strength, Strong Capital Base, Cost Engineering at Scale, Late Entrant Advantage and Zero Tech-Debt.
- Business model is framed in three layers: Layer 1 proprietary suite of products, Layer 2 marketplace aggregation of third-party products, and Layer 3 'The Core Pivot' of proactive hyper-personalisation with an AI-native, conversational, 'N=1' interface.
- Allianz Jio Reinsurance 'commands priority market access as India's third licensed domestic reinsurer' and secured lead reinsurer status on major treaty programs across prominent private insurers.
- JFSL is a publicly-listed entity (CIC) acting as holding company for the group; subsidiaries include JCL (NBFC, RBI), JPBL (Payments Bank, RBI), JPSL (Payment Aggregator, RBI), JIBL (Insurance Broking, IRDAI), JFPSL, JLSL, RIIHL (unregistered CIC) and RSHL, all 100%.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Consolidation] Full consolidation of Reliance Services and Holdings Limited (RSHL) as a 100% step-down subsidiary with effect from April 30, 2026; it was earlier accounted for under Share of Associates and Joint Ventures.
- [JV structure] BlackRock JVs (AMC, Trustee, Investment Advisers, Broking) and Allianz JVs (Allianz Jio Reinsurance, Jio Allianz General Insurance) are each held 50:50; Reliance International Leasing IFSC is a 50% JV with Reliance Strategic Business Ventures, regulated by IFSCA.
- [Investor base] JioBlackRock AMC reports 600+ institutional and ~1.2mn retail investors, 44% of investors with active SIPs, 36% of retail AUM from B30 cities versus an industry average of 28% (AMFI), and 18.5% of investors new to mutual funds.
- [Insurance broking] JIBL premium facilitated increased ~11x YoY and ~51% QoQ through the Digital POSP channel, with 200+ tailored D2C journeys; the premium facilitated mix is shown as an even 50:50 retail/corporate split in the latest period versus a 29%/71% split in the earlier period.

### Segment P&Ls
- **Jio Credit (NBFC):** NII Rs 257 cr (+118% YoY); PPOP Rs 154 cr (+128%); PAT Rs 96 cr (+113%, >2x). Gross AUM Rs 30,667 cr (+163% YoY / 2.6x). Disbursements >Rs 11,000 cr (+173% YoY, fully organic). Borrowings ~Rs 28,000 cr, D:E 3.9x, cost of borrowing 7.07% (among lowest in industry). Raised Rs 1,500 cr NCD in Jun-26 (vs Rs 15,000 cr board limit).
- **Jio Payments Bank:** Total income Rs 83 cr (7.7x YoY); deposits Rs 617 cr (+72% YoY); CASA base 3.9 mn (+51%); avg balance/customer Rs 1,540 (+16%). BC network 527,000 touchpoints vs 50,000 a year ago (10x). Operational turnaround achieved.
- **Jio Payment Solutions (JPSL):** TPV Rs 19,208 cr (2.5x YoY); gross fee & commission Rs 176 cr (6.4x); net fee & commission Rs 24 cr (3.4x); net processing margin 12 bps (vs 9 bps). Operational turnaround.
- **JioBlackRock AMC:** closing AUM Rs 18,412 cr (+21% QoQ); QAAUM Rs 17,979 cr (+8%); 1.2 mn retail investors (18.5% new-to-MF; 36% AUM beyond top-30 cities). Liquid funds crossed Rs 10,000 cr in Apr; Prism SIF NFO raised >Rs 150 cr (closed 13-Jul).
- **Insurance:** Allianz Jio Reinsurance underwrote Rs 266 cr in its first full quarter (India's 3rd licensed domestic reinsurer, lead status on majority treaties). Jio Insurance Broking facilitated Rs 238 cr premium, fee & commission income Rs 61 cr (+131% YoY); POSP network +11x YoY.

one-line thesis: JFS is scaling a full-stack, AI-native financial ecosystem faster than any Indian incumbent built theirs: Jio Credit gross AUM 2.6x YoY to Rs 30,667 cr, JioBlackRock AMC to Rs 18,412 cr in ~1 year, and both payments arms (Bank + Solutions) hit operational turnaround this quarter. Consol PAT +156% YoY to Rs 830 cr — but that is heavily dividend/treasury-aided (Rs 509 cr RIL dividend + Rs 210 cr FV gains); ex-dividend PBT was up a more sober 18% YoY to Rs 461 cr. The Rs 9,890 cr cumulative promoter warrant infusion gives huge growth firepower; the watch-item is whether lending asset quality holds as the young book seasons.

| Shareholders' equity | Rs 1.37 lakh cr | — | Rs 9,890 cr cumulative promoter warrant infusion (2nd tranche Rs 5,934 cr this qtr) |
> Headline PAT is flattered by a Rs 509 cr dividend (largely RIL, via RIIHL/RSHL) and Rs 210 cr treasury FV gains — the underlying operating engine is better read via ex-dividend PBT (+18%) and NBFC PAT (+113%). Disbursements >Rs 11,000 cr (+173% YoY, fully organic). Borrowings ~Rs 28,000 cr, D:E 3.9x, cost of borrowing 7.07% (among lowest in industry). Raised Rs 1,500 cr NCD in Jun-26 (vs Rs 15,000 cr board limit).
- **Jio Payments Bank:** Total income Rs 83 cr (7.7x YoY); deposits Rs 617 cr (+72% YoY); CASA base 3.9 mn (+51%); avg balance/customer Rs 1,540 (+16%). BC network 527,000 touchpoints vs 50,000 a year ago (10x). Operational turnaround achieved.
- **Jio Payment Solutions (JPSL):** TPV Rs 19,208 cr (2.5x YoY); gross fee & commission Rs 176 cr (6.4x); net fee & commission Rs 24 cr (3.4x); net processing margin 12 bps (vs 9 bps). Operational turnaround.
- **JioBlackRock AMC:** closing AUM Rs 18,412 cr (+21% QoQ); QAAUM Rs 17,979 cr (+8%); 1.2 mn retail investors (18.5% new-to-MF; 36% AUM beyond top-30 cities). Liquid funds crossed Rs 10,000 cr in Apr; Prism SIF NFO raised >Rs 150 cr (closed 13-Jul).
